_README: Item Group definitions. Data, not code.
THREE NAMES, THREE AUDIENCES. None has to match the others:
group key      SFX-Balloons     maintenance + Render lookup + Pipedrive label
section_name   Balloon Effects  what the CLIENT reads on the quote
code prefix    BAL-             what determines membership
Group key and Pipedrive option label MUST stay identical - the sync matches
on them. The section name is referenced by nothing and is supplied at write
time, so it is free. It does not need to be unique: SFX-Wristbands-Zone and
SFX-Wristbands-Pixel both render as 'LED Wristbands', and a quote with both
selected shows two sections under the same heading, which is correct.
This split exists because Quoter has NO setting to hide section headings
(checked 2026-08-24). Whatever a section is called WILL appear on the
client's quote.
MEMBERSHIP resolves three ways:
code_prefixes  DERIVABLE baseline. Add a BAL- item and it joins
SFX-Balloons by construction. Nothing to maintain.
include_codes  cross-family items a prefix cannot capture - specialist
labour, shared controllers, cross-product accessories.
exclude_codes  prefix matches that do not belong.
RETIREMENT IS HANDLED BY PREFIX, NOT BY EXCLUSION. The catalog already
encodes current vs legacy in the code:
LED-WBT-*  TLC wristbands, current   LED-WBX-*  Xylobands, legacy
LED-LYT-*  TLC lanyard, current      LED-LYX-*  Xylo lanyard, legacy
HG-FVV-*   Vdisplay, current         HG-FVH-*   Hypervsn, phasing out
Groups take only the current prefix, so legacy items stay in the catalog
for servicing kit in the field but cannot be newly quoted. No exclude list
to maintain, and nothing silently reappears.
PREFIX DISCIPLINE IS LOAD-BEARING. A mistyped prefix silently drops an item
with no error. Known offenders 2026-08-24:
PYRO-FIR-REAL   PYRO- not PYR- (worked around with a second prefix)
T&E-BUY-OUT     no -NNN suffix (still matches T&E-)
MGS             Quoter demo item, no prefix
SPECIALIST vs GENERIC LABOUR. SVC- holds both. Specialist labour (robot
handler, laser technician, pyrotechnician, wristband tech) is included in
its own SFX- group. Generic labour (setup/strike, second technician,
overtime) is the shared SVC-General block. This is why SVC-General has no
code_prefixes - a blanket SVC- rule would put a robot handler on a balloon
quote.
AUTO-APPENDED GROUPS. A group with auto_append: true is added to every
quote by the composer and is NOT synced to the Pipedrive dropdown --
sales never sees it and cannot select it twice. position: 'first' puts
it ahead of the selected groups. Currently only SCO-ScopeOfWork.

SCO-ScopeOfWork.description: The narrative scope of the project. Auto-appended to every quote as the FIRST section; never selected in Pipedrive.
SCO-ScopeOfWork._why_automatic: Every quote should describe what is being sold, so leaving it to a dropdown choice means someone can forget. Auto-appending removes that failure mode and keeps the Quote Effects list shorter. It is also EXCLUDED FROM THE PIPEDRIVE SYNC: an option sales should never pick would only invite a duplicate Scope section.
SCO-ScopeOfWork._how_it_is_used: One line item, SCO-WORK-001 'Scope of Project', $0.00, whose DESCRIPTION carries placeholder text the salesperson rewrites per deal. Line item descriptions render client-facing; catalog item descriptions alone do not reach the quote (Chapter 3 12.2, 13.x) -- the composer copies the catalog description onto the line, which is what makes this work.
SCO-ScopeOfWork._not_priced: Narrative only. If Scope carried a project total AND the sections carried line prices, the client would see the money twice and the two could disagree after editing.

SFX-Balloons.description: Balloon effects. Shared blocks live in SVC-General and STE-.

SFX-FloatingVideo.description: Holographic fans. HG-FVV = Vdisplay (current), HG-FVH = Hypervsn (being phased out), HG-FV-Graph = manufacturer-neutral graphics packages.
SFX-FloatingVideo._note: HG-FVH-* (Hypervsn) deliberately EXCLUDED by prefix, not by exclude_codes: the prefix rule simply does not match them. They stay in the catalog for servicing units in the field but cannot be newly quoted. Same pattern as LED-WBX-.

SFX-Wristbands-Zone.description: Zone-based wristbands: 10 zones, group-level control by demographic segment, 433MHz. Pick this AND SFX-Wristbands-Pixel if unsure which the show needs; prune in the quote.
SFX-Wristbands-Zone._note: LED-WBX-* (Xylobands) and LED-LYX-* are the legacy line and are excluded by prefix. WBT = TLC current, WBX = Xylo legacy.

SFX-Wristbands-Pixel.description: Pixel wristbands: individual control, up to 100 groups, Excel-driven with real-time selection. TX305 and TX306 are functionally equivalent; 306 is the higher-cost build used at larger scale.

SFX-Lanyards.description: LED lanyards. TX306 is shared with pixel wristbands.
SFX-Lanyards._note: LED-LYX-001 (Xylo lanyard) is legacy and excluded by prefix.

SFX-GlowBalls.description: Inflatable LED glow balls, 40/60/90cm. TX305 drives these as well as orbs.
SFX-GlowBalls._unconfirmed: Is LED-GLOBAL-* the beach balls? Reads as GLOw BALl and the sizes are inflatable-shaped, but confirm.

SFX-GlowOrbs.description: Tabletop glow orbs. Table-scale work; 150 tables has been the largest to date.
SFX-GlowOrbs._unconfirmed: Does LED-GLOTX-10 (DMX transmitter) serve orbs as well as balls? Currently in SFX-GlowBalls only.

SFX-Pyro.description: Pyro, flame and fire effects. Includes the licensed pyrotechnician and permit, which are not optional for most of this.
SFX-Pyro._note: Two prefixes because PYRO-FIR-REAL is miscoded (PYRO- rather than PYR-). Worth normalising.

SFX-Fog.description: Fog, low-lying fog, foggers, fans and cryo.
SFX-Fog._unconfirmed: CO2- is cryo (Cryo Jet, high-pressure lines) rather than fog. Kept together because they are quoted together; split into SFX-Cryo if that is wrong.

SFX-Tanks.description: CO2, helium and nitrogen tanks, delivery and service.

SFX-Projection.description: Projection, mapping, media servers and content.

SFX-Drones.description: Indoor and outdoor drone shows and activations.

SVC-General.description: Generic labour that is not specific to any one effect. Specialist labour lives inside its own SFX- group instead.
SVC-General._note: No code_prefixes: SVC- alone would sweep in every specialist technician (robot handler, laser tech, pyrotechnician) and put them on every quote. Membership is explicit.

STE-All-In.description: Freight, airfare, lodging, ground, per diem, meals and parking, itemised and priced into the quote total. The alternative is STE-After-Bill, which is the same scope as a single $0.00 explanatory line instead.

STE-After-Bill.description: Same scope as STE-All-In but billed separately after the event. ONE explanatory line item, not the 19 itemised ones.
STE-After-Bill._status: NOT YET BUILT - the catalog item does not exist. Create it first.

_catalog_item_needed.name: T&E - Billed After Event
_catalog_item_needed.description_draft: Travel and expenses are not included in this quote. Airfare, lodging, meals, per diem, ground transport and shipping will be invoiced at actual cost following the event.
_catalog_item_needed._wording_note: This sentence appears on every after-bill quote and functions as a contract term. 'Not included' and 'at actual cost' are the load-bearing phrases. Needs sign-off from whoever owns client-facing language before it ships.
_catalog_item_needed._why_zero_priced: A $0.00 line renders correctly across API response, admin preview, webview and PDF (Chapter 3 7.5). Quantity must be 1 - the API rejects quantity 0, though it accepts unit_price 0.
_catalog_item_needed._why_this_code: Deliberately NOT T&E-AFTER-001. STE-All-In takes every item with a T&E- prefix, so a T&E- code would sweep the explanatory line onto itemised quotes too. A different prefix keeps the two groups disjoint with no exclude_codes to maintain.
_catalog_item_needed._check_when_created: Confirm whether the item DESCRIPTION renders on the client-facing quote or only in the admin view. Previewed quotes so far show name, qty, price and total with no description column. If descriptions do not show, the statement has to live in the item NAME instead.

STE-After-Bill._no_code_prefix: Membership is explicit, like SVC-General. A prefix rule would sweep in the T&E- items this group exists to replace.

_unassigned.note: In the catalog but not yet in any group. Decide: own group, folded into an existing one, or deliberately left out.
_unassigned.EQP-* (9): truss, pipe & base, nitrogen regulator, equipment damage - support kit, plausibly a shared block
_unassigned.FIN-* (6): warranties, ACH details, postponement costs - commercial terms rather than product
_unassigned.LED remainder (~19): walls, tubes, floor, screens, panels, mesh, letters, costumes, signage - candidate SFX-LEDDisplays
_unassigned.LED-WB-HTX1 / LED-WBE-HTX: HTX controller deposit and remote. UNCONFIRMED whether HTX retires alongside Xylo. Currently in no group.

_planned.note: nothing planned but unbuilt beyond STE-After-Bill, which now sits in groups with _status set
